title: Sony acknowledges backlash, “cautiously” moves ahead with end of PlayStation discs
summary: Sony is “cautiously” moving forward with plans to stop producing discs for PlayStation games as of January 2028, CFO Lin Tao said through an interpreter today. And we’re going to cautiously move this forward,” Tao said.
